caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Passage of Hindū Kush mountains over the Khāwak and Kaoshān passes.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: From Nikaia (probably Jalālābād), Alexander with picked force proceeds to the subjugation of the mountains ; Hephaistion with rest of army advancing to the Indus, probably through the valley of the Kābul river.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Capture of stronghold of Astes (Hasti) by Hephaistion after thirty days' siege.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Alexander subdivides his force, advancing in person against the Aspasians ; he crosses the Gouraios (Panjkora) river, captures Massaga of the Assakenians, and massacres 7,000 Indian mercenaries.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Siege of Aornos.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Capture of Aornos.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Arrival of Alexander at bridge-head at Ohind.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Halt of army for thirty days.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Passage of Indus ' in beginning of spring ' ; halt at Taxila.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Advance eastward.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Arrival at the Hydaspes (Jihlam) river.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Battle of the Hydaspes ; defeat of Pōros.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Foundation of Nikaia and Boukephala ; passage of the Akesinēs (Chināb) river near the foot of the hills.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Passage of the Hydraōtes (Rāvi) river, and conflict with the Kathaeans.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Arrival at the Hyphasis (Biās) river ; refusal of army to proceed farther.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: The Retreat.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Retirement to the Hydaspes (Jihlam) river.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Commencement of voyage down the rivers, and of march of army escorting the fleet.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Collapse of the Mallian power.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Voyage continued, fighting with the Sogdoi, Sambos, Mousikanos, &c.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Departure of Alexander to march through Gedrosia.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Nearchos starts on voyage to the Persian Gulf.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Arrival of Alexander at Poura (Bāmpur), the Gedro- sian capital, sixty days distant from Ora.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Halt of army at Poura.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: March through Karmania, about 300 miles.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
row_label: End of April or beginning of May
raw_text: Arrival at Sūsa in Persia, after about 500 miles of marching from western frontier of Karmania.

caption: From May, 327, to May, 324 b. c.
raw_text: Death of Alexander at Babylon.
